ruleDefinitions.name: PUA - Chisel Tunneling Tool Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects usage of the Chisel tunneling tool via the commandline arguments

sequences.query: process_path = RGX("\\\\chisel\\\.exe$") OR ((process_command_line = RGX(".*exe\\ client\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*exe\\ server\\ .*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-socks5.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-reverse.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ r\\:.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:127\\\.0\\\.0\\\.1\\:.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-tls\\-skip\\-verify\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:socks.*")))
